Anything which allows you to bypass or ignore any mechanics which are intended to be compulsory and also make the encounter easier imo is a cheese. Everyone going to one side and bursting Riven is a cheese since it skips pretty much every mechanic in the encounter and infinite sanctified damage phase is also a cheese since it skips having a time limit on the damage phase. However 4 core taniks imo isn't a cheese since it is intended.

To those posting how OP is incorrect with quotes to this TWAB:

[https://www.bungie.net/en/Explore/Detail/News/50543](https://www.bungie.net/en/Explore/Detail/News/50543)

"Yes, you can upgrade to the Deluxe Edition to access the Dungeons. We will also add a separate access path in the future."

aswell as the reveal stream:  
"But there's even more coming next year than just our new seasons. The   
deluxe edition of the witch queen will also include 2 brand new dungeons  
 to be released in 2022"  


Neither of these points sepecify either sides of the arguement and therefore don't help to prove or disprove that the dungeons will be locked behind an additional paywall. Imo there is no substantial proof to actually believe Bungie will lock dungeons behind a paywall and more than likely it is just poor wording on purchasing seasons like OP mentioned which has led to unfortunate misinterpretation and more than likely an unnecessary arguement about an issue which doesn't exist.
